text:
alex_lee: hey team :wave: first day here. quick q — who should I ping to get access to Console staging admin panels and feature-flag operator role? I couldn't find the exact step in the onboarding doc.

samira: welcome! :tada: ping @marta_g for infra perms. short path: fill the infra-access form (https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests) and attach your manager. if you need staging ff-operator that's usually auto-granted when you join the redwood-console-staging-operators group.

marta_g: hi Alex — added details: for staging we grant 'FF Operator' + 'Console Editor' for 7 days by default. For prod: request needs manager + security review. Steps:

1) Open https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests
2) Select 'Console' -> env: staging or prod
3) role: FF Operator (or Console Readonly for prod)
4) attach manager approval

CLI quick request:
```
/request-access --resource console --env staging --role ff-operator --duration 7d --manager @samira
```

I'll approve once the form is in.

devex-bot: Heads up: docs updated for onboarding: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/console-access. If you run into 403s check SSO group membership: redwood-console-staging-operators or redwood-console-prod-operators.

alex_lee: thanks! one more — I need a service account for local e2e against staging (no prod). any special tags or KMS access needed?

ryan: for staging SA: create via iam portal, include 'e2e-staging' tag. don't request KMS unless you need secrets access; if you do, add a separate KMS request and attach a justification. prod KMS requests require two approvers.

marta_g: If you want me to create the SA with limited scopes I can — send me the repo + CI job name. Also make sure you enable 2FA on your account — infra will block requests from accounts without MFA.

alex_lee: repo is github.com/redwood/integrations-e2e, job name `e2e:staging`. adding manager @samira to the form now. thanks all :pray:

samira: got it — approved the request. @marta_g feel free to create SA when ready.

marta_g: creating SA now, will post credentials in the secrets-onboarding channel with access restricted. tagging when done.

devex-bot: Reminder: temporary creds expire after 7 days. Use `iam rotate-token --name e2e-staging` to refresh. Playbook: https://runbook.redwood.com/e2e-sa

alex_lee: awesome — confirmed I can open the Console staging, can see feature flags panel. thanks y'all :raised_hands:
